text:
jade.p: FYI — proposing a shadow-pricing run next week: apply new price sheet in parallel (no invoice changes) for observability, then follow with a staggered cutover. Need ops sign-off on export flags, canary selection, and holdback policy.

kevin.s: Shadow run is great. Two asks: 1) ensure we tag shadow exports with invoice.metadata.shadow_run=true and 2) export calculated net_due_shadow so analytics can diff.

mira.l: Also: define the canary selection. Recommend deterministic sample: customers with last_digit(customer_id) in [1,2,3,4,5] and not grandfathered. Keeps randomness reproducible.

oscar.b: Billing safeties: if net_due_shadow - net_due_live > 7% for any customer OR abs(delta) > $12k, place invoice in HOLD state and create a review ticket. We shouldn't auto-issue credits from shadow.

billing-bot: [automated] Shadow experiment created: shadow_parity_2026 | cohort=platform_early | start=2026-09-07 | id=exp_shadow_20260907

jade.p: On vendor settlements: do NOT change vendor payout lines during shadow or cutover. Any discount absorption must be an internal GL adjustment (acct 7010 vendor_subsidy).

kevin.s: For holdback workflow: invoice.hold_reason = "pricing_delta_threshold"; create jira ticket billing-hold/<invoice_id> with fields: cust, est_delta, shadow_row_id. Approvers: finance_manager or billing_lead.

mira.l: Edge cases: customers with committed prepaid credits could flip negative. Shadow should simulate credits but not mark invoices negative. Keep a simulated_credit_balance field in shadow export for visibility.

oscar.b: Monitoring: add metric `shadow.delta.median` and alert if median > 2% or if >3 invoices hit hold in first 24h. Add a dashboard widget with top 25 deltas.

jade.p: Rollout plan: 1) shadow run Thursday 02:00 PT 2) review CSV and holdbacks Friday 11:00 PT 3) canary export Monday for 20 customers 4) soft launch for cohort Wednesday 08:00 PT 5) full rollout after 72h if signals green.

kevin.s: Automation: a small migration to add invoice.metadata.shadow_run and invoice.metadata.shadow_net_due. Rollback is dropping flags and re-exporting live prices. Keep migration in a single deploy to avoid schema drift.

mira.l: Success criteria: fewer than 5 held invoices, median delta < 2%, and no single customer > $20k delta. If thresholds exceed, pause and revert pricing via experiment flag.

oscar.b: Sales exemptions: SFDC tag "shadow-exempt" to exclude from canary. Legal signs off on exemptions > $50k ARR.

jade.p: I'll publish the checklist and the S3 path for shadow export in Drive. Please review the canary list by EOD so we can lock it. :white_check_mark:
